cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll unlock the storeroom if you cover my break. Remember what I taught you about returning favours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's coffee all over the lobby. Just tell me where the mop is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Behind the buckets. Good, you've learned to ask a smaller favour. Five minutes' cover for that; ten more for the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lend me the key. I'll mop, then cover your break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better sequence. But lending isn't the same as opening. The key costs tomorrow's break too. You're learning to negotiate; don't leave out half the price.
